name: plex
description: Plex Media Server integration — search your libraries, inspect item details, list libraries, browse recently added and On Deck items, see active playback sessions, and trigger library scans on your own Plex server. Authenticates with a static owner/admin X-Plex-Token (Plex's 'Legacy' token auth — powerful, guard it carefully) sent on every request together with Accept: application/json and a fixed X-Plex-Client-Identifier. Self-hosted: your Plex server (usually a LAN address like http://192.168.1.50:32400) must be reachable from Sophon's sandbox — LAN-only servers need a VPN, tunnel, or reverse proxy.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Plex Media Server libraries, sessions, and scans via the Plex HTTP API

fields.label: Plex Server URL
fields.helpText: Base URL of your Plex Media Server (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:32400). Must be reachable from Sophon's sandbox — LAN-only servers need a VPN, tunnel, or reverse proxy.

fields.label: X-Plex-Token
fields.helpText: Your owner/admin X-Plex-Token: in Plex Web open any library item > Get Info > View XML, then copy the X-Plex-Token value from the URL. Warning: this token is admin-powerful — it grants full control of your server.

tools.name: plex.search_library
tools.description: Search Plex for items matching a query — across all libraries, or within one library section if sectionId is given. Returns title, type, year, ratingKey, and library section for each match.

query.description: Search text, e.g. a movie or show title

sectionId.description: Library section key to search within (from plex.list_libraries). Omit to search all libraries.

tools.name: plex.get_item_details
tools.description: Get details of a library item by ratingKey — summary, year, rating, duration, and trimmed media stream info (resolution, codecs, container, bitrate).

ratingKey.description: The item's ratingKey (from search or listing tools)

tools.name: plex.list_libraries
tools.description: List the library sections on the Plex server with each section's key, title, type (movie, show, artist, photo), and metadata agent.

tools.name: plex.get_recently_added
tools.description: List recently added items — server-wide, or for one library section if sectionId is given.

sectionId.description: Library section key to list recently added items from. Omit for server-wide.

tools.name: plex.get_active_sessions
tools.description: List active playback sessions — who is watching what, on which player, and how far along they are.

tools.name: plex.get_on_deck
tools.description: List On Deck items (continue-watching queue) across the server.

tools.name: plex.scan_library_section
tools.description: Trigger a scan (refresh) of a library section so Plex picks up new or changed files.

sectionId.description: Library section key to scan (from plex.list_libraries)
